paragraphs.chinese:
这一集发生在开学第一天。孩子们要重新回到学校，但看起来，比他们更难适应这件事的其实是家长。

邓菲家的早晨完全是一片混乱。卢克几乎还没开始写当天就要交的暑假日记，海莉正为驾驶课紧张，所有人都急着赶快出门。

孩子们离开后，克莱尔很期待在家里安静地过一天。菲尔却以为她一定很孤单。他取消了一个工作安排，留下来陪她，还提议两个人一起去跑步。

克莱尔说自己平时都是一个人跑，因为她比菲尔快得多。菲尔把这当成了挑战，于是两个人同意比赛。克莱尔确信自己会赢，但跑到一半时，她意识到真正难以接受孩子重新上学的人其实是菲尔。于是她故意放慢速度，让菲尔赢了。菲尔像拿了奥运冠军一样庆祝，结果几秒钟后就被海莉的驾校训练车撞到了。

与此同时，曼尼想在开学第一天穿一件传统的哥伦比亚斗篷。格洛丽亚很喜欢，但杰担心其他孩子会嘲笑他。他拿这套衣服开了好几个玩笑，曼尼听完后，默默地在上学前把斗篷脱了下来。

格洛丽亚在车里发现斗篷后，非常生气。她告诉杰，曼尼很崇拜他，所以他说的话会产生很大影响。杰解释说，他只是想保护曼尼，不希望他被别人欺负，但格洛丽亚坚持认为，他们应该支持孩子。于是两个人把斗篷送回了学校。

随后，曼尼又说自己还准备吹排箫，并在全班面前表演哥伦比亚舞蹈。格洛丽亚突然觉得，整套表演可能确实有点过头，于是让杰把排箫弄坏。杰高兴地一脚踩了上去，还假装这只是个意外。

米切尔这一天也过得非常紧张。他一直在给家里做各种婴儿安全防护，因为他特别害怕莉莉会受伤。卡梅隆觉得他需要放松，于是让他抱着莉莉跳舞。结果米切尔不小心让莉莉的头撞到了墙上，两个人立刻把她送去了医院。

医生说莉莉没事，还提醒他们，所有新手父母都会犯错。米切尔还是担心卡梅隆天生更会当父亲，但卡梅隆指出了米切尔为这个家庭所做的许多重要事情。两个人刚刚认定自己是一支很棒的育儿团队，就又不小心把莉莉锁在了车里。

到了最后，孩子们都顺利度过了开学第一天。反而是家长们花了一整天担心、犯错，还为了保护孩子而用力过猛。
paragraphs.english:
This episode takes place on the first day of school. The kids are heading back to class, but the parents seem to have a harder time with it than they do.

At the Dunphy house, the morning is complete chaos. Luke has barely started the summer journal that’s due that day, Haley is nervous about her driving lesson, and everyone is rushing to get out the door.

Once the kids are gone, Claire is looking forward to having a quiet day at home. Phil, however, assumes she must feel lonely. He cancels a work appointment to keep her company and suggests they go running together.

Claire says she normally runs alone because she’s much faster than him. Phil takes this as a challenge, and the two agree to race. Claire is confident she’ll win, but during the race, she realizes that Phil is the one who’s having trouble with the kids going back to school. She slows down and lets him win. Phil celebrates like he’s won the Olympics, only to get hit by Haley’s driving-school car a few seconds later.

Meanwhile, Manny wants to wear a traditional Colombian poncho on his first day. Gloria loves it, but Jay worries that the other children will make fun of him. He makes several jokes about the outfit, and Manny quietly takes it off before school.

When Gloria finds the poncho in the car, she’s angry. She tells Jay that Manny looks up to him, so his comments matter. Jay explains that he’s only trying to protect Manny from being picked on, but Gloria insists that they should support him. They take the poncho back to school.

Then Manny reveals that he also plans to play a pan flute and perform a Colombian dance for the class. Gloria suddenly decides the full performance may be too much and tells Jay to break the flute. Jay happily steps on it and pretends it was an accident.

Mitchell is also having a stressful day. He’s been baby-proofing the house because he’s terrified that Lily will get hurt. Cameron thinks he needs to relax, so he gets Mitchell to dance with her. Mitchell accidentally bumps Lily’s head against the wall, and they rush her to the doctor.

The doctor says Lily is fine and reminds them that all new parents make mistakes. Mitchell still worries that Cameron is a more natural father, but Cameron points out all the important things Mitchell does for their family. Just as they decide they make a great team, they accidentally lock Lily inside the car.

By the end, the children have handled their first day just fine. It’s the parents who spend the whole day worrying, making mistakes, and trying a little too hard to protect them.
